answer: The inlet opens only during the comet window, a 36-hour admission period that returns on a fixed orbit. Each identity entering pays a toll fixed at the previous epoch's summit tally: 8,000 POA plus 3,000 for every identity that entered before it in the same window. The toll burns immediately and never returns. An operator seeding N fake identities pays an ascending price, so the last member of its batch costs 8,000 + 3,000(N-1) more than the first and nothing is recoverable at any point; bulk registration collapses its own margin while a lone honest entrant pays once.
